senses.gloss: (Pilp. of <cite ref="B00406"><he>בז</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="B00436"><he>בְּזָא</he> II</cite>, a. b. h.  in H. in H. Dict.)
to divide, distribute. Tosef. Meg. IV (III), 21 אין אדם מְבַזְבֵּז בידיו לעצמו (v. ed. Zuck. Var.) one who distributes (honors) must take none to himself.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 142a">B. Bath. 142ᵃ</cite> a convert died <he>ובזבזו וכ׳</he> and Israelites divided his property among themselves (he having left no legitimate heirs).

senses.gloss: to give away liberally, to give charity on a large scale.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 50a:2">Keth. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>הַמְבַזְבֵּז אל יְבַזְבֵּז וכ׳</he> he who wants to be liberal, must not give away more than &c.

<cite ref="Ketubot 50a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>קטנים כתבו ובזבזו</he> ‘minors’ ‘wrote’ and ‘gave away’ (ref. to the order of three traditions concerning minors, transfer of property and charity, related <cite ref="Ketubot 49b">ib. 49ᵇ</cite> sq.).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 11a:3">B. Bath. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>שבזבז וכ׳</he> who gave away to charities his own and his father’s treasures; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to divide spoils, to plunder, v. בָּזַז, בַּזְבּוּזָא &c.]
